title: Where a belt came from: the causes and the sentence each one prints (GEN.1088, docs/design/systems/belt-origins.md sections 3 to 5)
note: A formation cause says what made the belt; a shaping cause says what took mass from it afterwards. The text is a Python format string over the fields named in 'fields'. Rates, widths and survival factors are constants of physics/belt_origin.py with registry rows in section 6.94 of the gap filling plan.

gap.label: gap in the planet chain
gap.text: The leftover of a planet that never grew here: the chain of planets skips from {inner_neighbour_au:.3g} AU to {outer_neighbour_au:.3g} AU, and the solids between stayed small.

tail.label: unfinished tail of the planet chain
tail.text: The unfinished end of the planet chain: planets stopped forming past {inner_neighbour_au:.3g} AU, and the solids out to {outer_au:.3g} AU never grew into one.

snow-line-bump.label: solids piled up at the snow line
snow-line-bump.text: Solids piled up at the snow line, which stood at {snow_line_au:.3g} AU when the system formed, and never finished growing.
snow-line-bump.co_text: Solids also piled up here, at the snow line of the young system, {snow_line_au:.3g} AU.

outer-disc.label: cold leftover beyond the last giant
outer-disc.text: The cold leftover of the disc past {inner_au:.3g} AU: the solids were too sparse and the orbits too slow to build a planet.

collisional-debris.label: rubble of a collision
collisional-debris.text: The rubble of a collision between large bodies near {event_au:.3g} AU, still spread along their orbit.

destroyed-planet.label: remains of a destroyed planet
destroyed-planet.text: What is left of a planet that was destroyed near {event_au:.3g} AU.

giant-stirring.label: cleared and stirred by a giant
giant-stirring.text: The giant at {giant_au:.3g} AU cleared {removed_percent:.2g} percent of it and stirs the rest.
giant-stirring.alt_text: The giant at {giant_au:.3g} AU stirs it.

instability-depletion.label: swept by a moving giant
instability-depletion.text: A giant that moved from {giant_from_au:.3g} AU to {giant_au:.3g} AU swept away {removed_percent:.3g} percent of it.
